subject: English
passage: The rise of online gaming platforms has provided psychologists with new opportunities to observe human behavior in real time. A striking recent case involves the emergence of collaborative problem-solving strategies among players of multiplayer puzzle games. Researchers documented these strategies first appearing in game chat systems, where players developed shorthand communication methods to coordinate complex moves; subsequently, these same coordination techniques began appearing in players' workplace team meetings and group projects outside the gaming environment. Psychologists have identified numerous similar instances of this pattern across different gaming communities, suggesting that online gaming platforms ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: are more effective for studying competitive behavior than for studying cooperative behavior.
choices.B: appear to be having an unusually significant impact on the development of collaborative skills in puzzle game players.
choices.C: may provide psychologists with an incomplete picture of how human behavior develops.
choices.D: do not simply document behavioral changes but can actually promote the development of such changes.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of psychologists using online gaming platforms to observe human behavior in real time, providing the specific example of collaborative problem-solving strategies among multiplayer puzzle game players. The text states that researchers first documented these strategies appearing in game chat systems, where players developed coordination techniques; subsequently, these same techniques began appearing in players' workplace meetings and group projects outside the gaming environment. As presented in the text, this progression from online gaming behavior to real-world workplace behavior suggests that gaming platforms do more than just document or observe behavioral changes—they can actively foster such changes. In the case of collaborative strategies, the text suggests, online gaming facilitated the transfer of coordination skills from virtual environments to real-world professional settings.
